sql.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM author WHERE name = 'utc' AND created_ts BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 minute' AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + INTERVAL '1 minute'
